purpose: Check the directly linked original community experiment for an actual-size observation bridge
source: Figshare article 11704749; DOI 10.26180/5e2a1a8d74be7, cited by Ecology 2020 DOI 10.1002/ecy.3015
allowed: Retain exact public article metadata with a retrieval receipt
Acquire the one XLSX as opaque bytes after verifying the provider file identifier, length and MD5
Read workbook sheet names and first-row text headers only using the tested header parser
prohibited: Interpreting or emitting any numerical community data row
Fitting cost curves, assigning bins from community outcomes or computing a law score
rationale: The original methods describe microscopy of community cells. A table header may identify retained cell-level measurements or uncertainty fields; the 2020 derived-estimate workbook headers alone cannot establish absence of such records.
